mission.title: cilium: CFP: Expose configurable Envoy Access Logs for L7 observability and Gateway API
mission.description: CFP: Expose configurable Envoy Access Logs for L7 observability and Gateway API. Requested by 36+ users.

steps.title: Check current cilium deployment
steps.description:
Verify your cilium version and configuration:
```bash
kubectl get pods -n cilium -l app.kubernetes.io/name=cilium
helm list -n cilium 2>/dev/null || echo "Not installed via Helm"
```
This feature requires a working cilium installation.

steps.title: Review cilium configuration
steps.description:
Inspect the relevant cilium configuration:
```bash
kubectl get all -n cilium -l app.kubernetes.io/name=cilium
kubectl get configmap -n cilium -l app.kubernetes.io/part-of=cilium
```
## Cilium Feature Proposal

**Is your proposed feature related to a problem?**

Unable to expose or configure the Envoy Access Logs described here: https://www.envoyproxy.io/docs/envoy/latest/configuration/observability/access_log/usage

Enabling

steps.title: Apply the fix for CFP: Expose configurable Envoy Access Logs for L7…
steps.description:
A decent workaround is using hubble export for these flow logs, when configured like this, they appear in the cilium pod stdout as json: (see https://github.com/cilium/cilium/issues/31357#issuecomment-3746772007 for reference)
```
    hubble:  
      export:
        dynamic:
          enabled:
```yaml
hubble:  
      export:
        dynamic:
          enabled: true
          config:
            enabled: true
            content:
              # https://docs.cilium.io/en/stable/_api/v1/flow/README/
              - name: "l7-http-stdout"
                filePath: "/dev/stdout"
                # imaginative value for stream to not rotate /dev/stdout
                fileMaxSizeMb: 2137
                fileMaxBackups: 0
                fieldMask:
                  - time
                  - verdict
                  - IP
                  - l7.type
                  - l7.latency_ns
             
```

steps.title: Verify the feature works
steps.description:
Test that the new capability is working as expected:
```bash
kubectl get pods -n cilium -l app.kubernetes.io/name=cilium
kubectl get events -n cilium --sort-by='.lastTimestamp' | tail -10
```
Confirm the feature described in "CFP: Expose configurable Envoy Access Logs for L7…" is functioning correctly.

resolution.summary:
A decent workaround is using hubble export for these flow logs, when configured like this, they appear in the cilium pod stdout as json: (see https://github.com/cilium/cilium/issues/31357#issuecomment-3746772007 for reference)
```
    hubble:  
      export:
        dynamic:
          enabled: true
          config:
            enabled: true
            content:
              #
codeSnippets:
hubble:  
      export:
        dynamic:
          enabled: true
          config:
            enabled: true
            content:
              # https://docs.cilium.io/en/stable/_api/v1/flow/README/
              - name: "l7-http-stdout"
                filePath: "/dev/stdout"
                # imaginative value for stream to not rotate /dev/stdout
                fileMaxSizeMb: 2137
                fileMaxBackups: 0
                fieldMask:
                  - time
                  - verdict
                  - IP
                  - l7.type
                  - l7.latency_ns
                  - l7.http.code
                  - l7.http.method
                  - l7.http.url
                  - l7.http.protocol
                  - Summary
                  - destination.pod_name
